settings.headline: See the story behind every customer.
settings.intro: TraceKit connects available acquisition, identity, commerce, and financial evidence into a traceable journey—so you can understand what happened after the click.
settings.note: Completeness depends on available source data and supported integrations.

settings.heading: From click to customer
settings.body: Follow known identifiers and deterministic relationships between traffic, identity, and commerce.

settings.heading: Beyond the first order
settings.body: Preserve upsells, subscriptions, rebills, refunds, disputes, and adjustments as distinct events.

settings.heading: Evidence at every step
settings.body: Inspect the source identifiers and records supporting each connection.

settings.heading: Honest about gaps
settings.body: See unresolved attribution and missing links rather than hiding them.
